In the right triangle shown above, what is the length of $KL$?

$$0$$

$$7$$
explanation: The correct answer is $7$. Triangle $KLM$ has given angle measures of $30 ^\circ$ and $90 ^\circ$, so the third angle must be $60 ^\circ$ because the measures of the angles of a triangle sum to $180 ^\circ$. For any special right triangle with angles measuring $30 ^\circ$, $60 ^\circ$, and $90 ^\circ$, the length of the hypotenuse (the side opposite the right angle) is $2x$, where $x$ is the length of the side opposite the $30 ^\circ$ angle. Segment $\overline{KL}$ is opposite the $30 ^\circ$ angle. Therefore, $2(KL) = 14$ and $KL = 7$.
